about_the_game:
In a world brimming with mystery and adventure, an unknown dark force has risen, stealing the precious Energy Spirit Stone and kidnapping a Spirit Realm Emissary. As the captain, you bear a grave responsibility to assemble an elite squad to traverse the Three Realms—Mortal, Spirit, and Demon—to uncover the mastermind behind this conspiracy and eliminate the dark forces lurking within.

Your mission: Lead your team to delve into the Three Realms, rescue the abducted detective, retrieve the Energy Spirit Stone, and punish the nefarious forces hiding in the shadows. Each realm presents unique challenges and secrets, and your decisions will sway the course of the battle.

Captain, your squad is in the midst of fierce combat. It's time to demonstrate your leadership and guide them to victory, restoring peace and order across the Three Realms. Are you ready? The call to battle has sounded, and the journey of heroes is about to commence.

Game Highlights

Charming Casual Fun: Enjoy a delightful and cute casual game with character card collection.

Physics-based Team Battles: Engage in small team confrontations, mastering the art of combat with a physics-driven approach.

Magical Adventures Await: Embark on fairy tales enriched with treasure hunts and puzzles, making your gaming experience both enchanting and engaging.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.5 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (e.g., Intel Iris)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 15.2 (Sonoma) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro/Max / Intel i7
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated (e.g., AMD Radeon Pro)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
